- **Berries and citrus fruits:** Provide polyphenols, anthocyanins, and vitamin C to help reduce inflammation and support fat metabolism. *(Note: Grapefruit can interact with certain medications.)*⁠YouTube·Med Today  +2[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Gtr--KPOJmE&t=118)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEBxCJF12hGQxEb8afRSjKCKw8A53t5vwcrbhKDTAJRlipxExs7YPf3a_tzZspq8LnjrQTLgXnGRReyOh1BYhx8XSMaC8JHtF3o1BbOn5QuAoQ5Omx2u699-dTrGfYP_zxK0UhH0OHtU_I9yRh-Q9fVyalMqXotTkJKbsPq5q0G8HwjAENmlc6Hecihb25thkaMhRRs)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QqYdUOA2z-k&t=252)

- **Vitamin E and milk thistle:** Vitamin E has been studied in specific fatty liver cases, while milk thistle has mixed evidence for effectiveness.⁠Mayo Clinic  +1[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES0wEBxCJF1yF4MKIKtkt6wum_W9eJU8hu8zrYW86gsqyE4ZSNymFec3Z5Pl_5X6H3hoWtA4NM_eyQw7d8uRkEDKEAx6QiHCSEu6BKwisSEEPGzy0zETFszYXL36U2fyLdi3vL0FPCip2_P62OR_qcvKttmGomVe7RTVvPyy_5oHlT7gIP3mwl5FfUYnTZm-4scKsKbi7FGVuY1XYIsGNnifTUsq9eoL7TjBefTw7Kzy-42l6DXM_Clc2txE_Xbw70GtstHf340PmAHid2Jp6OMj162544)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF1z-rkOzksZMjgwLfKsUOQaMuVlO7g0P54SI_Yh39l6UDgVW1_0kKjwytcAKMP5DsyMy9Ydle5fNTxTHdowBvgaSQys-VHjN7m3fhVl4BJ4uDkiEcxme1ek6kIZUHcfQAzGIrwpFMfJhzL5Oywim6rOXkxHNSqXLDfnFFGYvr4qHCB0XUFZRM8SBN-_Wy)
- **Avoid "detox" cleanses:** Products marketed to detox the liver lack proof of benefit and can harm the liver. Always check with a healthcare provider before starting supplements, especially if you take medications or have a liver condition.⁠Mayo Clinic  +1[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES0wEBxCJF1yF4MKIKtkt6wum_W9eJU8hu8zrYW86gsqyE4ZSNymFec3Z5Pl_5X6H3hoWtA4NM_eyQw7d8uRkEDKEAx6QiHCSEu6BKwisSEEPGzy0zETFszYXL36U2fyLdi3vL0FPCip2_P62OR_qcvKttmGomVe7RTVvPyy_5oHlT7gIP3mwl5FfUYnTZm-4scKsKbi7FGVuY1XYIsGNnifTUsq9eoL7TjBefTw7Kzy-42l6DXM_Clc2txE_Xbw70GtstHf340PmAHid2Jp6OMj162544)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEBxCJF12hGQxEb8afRSjKCKw8A53t5vwcrbhKDTAJRlipxExs7YPf3a_tzZspq8LnjrQTLgXnGRReyOh1BYhx8XSMaC8JHtF3o1BbOn5QuAoQ5Omx2u699-dTrGfYP_zxK0UhH0OHtU_I9yRh-Q9fVyalMqXotTkJKbsPq5q0G8HwjAENmlc6Hecihb25thkaMhRRs)
